chapters.title: BFS with column numbers

frames.caption: BFS with column numbers — O(n) time, O(n) extra space. Input: top_and_bottom_view(root=tree (1)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
node, col = queue.popleft() — ((1), 0) taken from the front of queue; col = 0
node, col = queue.popleft() — ((2), -1) taken from the front of queue; node moves to (2); col = -1
node, col = queue.popleft() — ((3), 1) taken from the front of queue; node moves to (3); col = 1
node, col = queue.popleft() — ((4), -2) taken from the front of queue; node moves to (4); col = -2
node, col = queue.popleft() — ((5), 0) taken from the front of queue; node moves to (5); col = 0
node, col = queue.popleft() — ((6), 0) taken from the front of queue; node moves to (6)
node, col = queue.popleft() — ((7), 2) taken from the front of queue; node moves to (7); col = 2
return [top[c] for c in cols], [bottom[c] for c in cols] — c = -2
return [top[c] for c in cols], [bottom[c] for c in cols] — c = -1
return [top[c] for c in cols], [bottom[c] for c in cols] — c = 0
return [top[c] for c in cols], [bottom[c] for c in cols] — c = 1
return [top[c] for c in cols], [bottom[c] for c in cols] — c = 2
return [top[c] for c in cols], [bottom[c] for c in cols] — c = -2
return [top[c] for c in cols], [bottom[c] for c in cols] — c = -1
return [top[c] for c in cols], [bottom[c] for c in cols] — c = 0
return [top[c] for c in cols], [bottom[c] for c in cols] — c = 1
return [top[c] for c in cols], [bottom[c] for c in cols] — c = 2
return [top[c] for c in cols], [bottom[c] for c in cols] — returns ([4, 2, 1, 3, 7], [4, 2, 6, 3, 7]). Result: ([4, 2, 1, 3, 7], [4, 2, 6, 3, 7])
